notes.text:
Whoops, the blossom goal didn't work. Here's a VERY small hotfix.

NOTE: v0.6.7 or higher of Archipelago is required due to the use of Rule Builder. This IS compatible with worlds generated prior to this version.

## Adjustments/fixes:
- (Level Pack) Fixed the Blossoms goal causing a script error.
Note: You should reinstall the level pack via /install_pack in the client to update the levelpack.

This contains the Baba Is You APWorld, the Babapelago levelpack, and extraslot.lua. ONLY THE APWORLD IS REQUIRED! It contains the levelpack as well and will automatically install the pack when starting. The levelpack is included in case this feature doesn't work for whatever reason, and extraslot.lua is a global mod needed to play more than three slots at once, if you wish to do so. The host only needs the APWorld no matter what.

For installation instructions and other information about this mod, PLEASE check out the [explanation page](worlds/baba_is_you/BABAPELAGO_README.md). Very important!

KNOWN ISSUES:
- I think this is fixed by now (have not encountered this in quite some time), but the client may suddenly stop sending checks in some situations. Closing and re-opening the client should fix the issue.
- There may be issues on Mac and Linux, since I haven't been able to test those myself. Please report any issues you experience.
- Logic has been well tested, although It was not feasible to test every possible combination of items. Please report any issues. In particular, Ultimate Maze's transforms are a complicated case.
